children: Burke & Herbert Financial Services reported $37.5 million of operating net income and an $11.0 billion balance sheet following the completed LINKBANCORP merger.
$37.5M operating net income for 2Q2026 after $28.2M of tax‑effected merger charges; adjusted diluted EPS $2.03.
Total assets rose to $11.0B and total deposits to $9.0B; gross loans $8.0B reflecting merged scale.
Merger closed May 1, 2026: $329.7M fully diluted consideration; tangible book value per share $49.23 (7.5% dilution).
Capital remained strong: CET1 12.1%, total risk‑based capital 14.4%, leverage ratio 11.8% as of June 30, 2026.
Adjusted efficiency ratio improved to 57.2% excluding $32.4M merger expenses; systems integration completed in June 2026.
